body.input: Which companies announced expanding into Norway in 2026?

response.content:
Here are companies that announced expansions into Norway in 2026, based on available information:

## Data Centers & AI Infrastructure

- **Bitzero Holdings Inc.** — Received two 60 MVA transformers to expand its Namsskogan data center in Norway to up to 110 MW of total capacity (including 40 MW already energized), supporting AI-focused colocation demand.
- **Polar Data Centers** — Expanded its partnership with **Crusoe** in Norway, announcing a new 40 MW AI infrastructure development (DRA02) at its facility in Tørdal, Norway (announced October 2026).
- **atNorth** — Expanded into Norway by acquiring land for its flagship NOR01 data center campus at Haugaland Business Park, a 36-hectare site designed for high-density and hyperscale deployments. Joined the Norwegian Data Center Industry association in June 2026.

## Defence & Technology

- **Arondite** (UK AI defence start-up) — Announced in November 2026 that it is expanding to Norway, opening its first international office in Oslo with a £35 million investment over five years to work with the Norwegian Armed Forces and NATO allies.

## Building & Technical Trade

- **Kesko Oyj** (Finland) — Completed the acquisition of Dahl's operations in Sweden and Brødrene Dahl's operations in Norway and Denmark from Saint-Gobain on 2 November 2026 for a debt-free price of EUR 1.2 billion. The acquired businesses had combined net sales of EUR 2.1 billion in 2025, strengthening Kesko's presence in HPAC and infrastructure in the Nordics.

## Financial & Business Services

- **Rantalainen** (Finland, backed by Norvestor) — Acquired the Business Services division of BDO in Norway, expanding its pan-Nordic platform for financial administration and payroll services.

## Aquaculture

- **Ode** — Expanded farmed cod production into Central Norway (Trøndelag) by acquiring a 51% stake in Namdal Settefisk, forming a new subsidiary (Ode Namdal AS) to operate six sea sites in the region.

## Software

- **Stratsys AB** (Sweden) — Expanded with a new office in Oslo, Norway, to serve Norwegian public and private sector customers with its governance and follow-up solutions.

## Entertainment

- **Activate** (gaming/entertainment) — Debuted in Norway (and Sweden) as part of its Nordic expansion, planning to open new locations in 2026.

## Energy Flexibility

- **Euroflex** (with Å Energi, NODES, Elvia, and Glitre Nett) — Expanded the NODESmarket flexibility market platform in Norway, covering grid areas with over 1.3 million electricity customers.

---

*Note: Norway's government announced in November 2026 a temporary halt on new electricity grid connections for data centers (via Statnett), which may affect future expansion plans in that sector.*

context.content: REYKJAVÍK, Iceland, June 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- atNorth, the leading Nordic high-density colocation and built-to-suit data center provider, today announced that it has joined the Norwegian Data Center Industry, an industry body representing the whole data center ecosystem in Norway. The announcement follows atNorth's recent expansion into Norway, marked by the acquisition of land for its flagship NOR01 data center campus at Haugaland Business Park, a 36-hectare site designed to support high-density workloads and hyperscale deployments. By joining the Norwegian Data Center Industry, atNorth aims to bolster collaboration between industry stakeholders, policymakers, and regional partners to support the continued growth of Norway's digital infrastructure ecosystem. The business is also a participant in global initiatives including theClimate Neutral Data Centre Pact and the UN Global Compact, as well as being an active member of the European Data Center Association (EUDCA) and other regional data center industry associations in the Nordics.

context.content: # Norway Halts Power Connections for New Data Centers. Norway will suspend further reservation of electricity connections for data centers while the country figures out how to handle the burden they place on the the grid. The measures introduced involve a temporary halt in new connection reservations, system operator Statnett AS said in a statement Monday. The halt is expected to be lifted no later than Aug. 1, 2027.
